about: Measured SHACL-phase seconds per distribution scale class and validation mode, read and written by tools/benchmark_atlas_shacl_scale.py. A run over toleranceRatio times its baseline fails; a run whose quad count is outside quadCountToleranceRatio of the baseline's is a different distribution, not a comparison. Baselines are machine-bound: re-record on new hardware, and re-record in the same commit as any shapes change whose new cost is accepted.
